title: A Young Adult edition of Tacitus's Histories
summary: The Histories of Tacitus now has a Young Adult edition: a faster, more dramatic retelling of all five books in plain, punchy English. It is a looser retelling, so use the Conversational English Translation and the notes when you need exactness. The notes and chapter pages were also checked against the Latin, and a number of small errors were fixed.

items.text: Added a Young Adult edition of the Histories of Tacitus. Pick it from the text menu; it covers all 389 verses and shows the study-note markers at the start of each verse.
Notes, manuscript differences and chapter pages for the Histories were rechecked against the Latin, with dozens of small corrections.
